messages.content: Selamat pagi. Saya Ravi, NaaS platform engineer Cyberjaya. Saya nak define assurance intent baru untuk customer GovTech MY — scope pakai 2 5G slices urllc+embb, KPIs latency p95 < 5ms urllc, availability 99.99%. Boleh tolong define dulu?
Selamat pagi Encik Ravi. Mendefinisikan intent assurance untuk GovTech MY sekarang.

function.name: define_assurance_intent
function.arguments: {"name": "GovTech MY 5G Critical Assurance Intent", "scope": {"customer_id": "cust-govtech-my", "slices": [{"sst": 2, "sd": "010203", "traffic_type": "urllc"}, {"sst": 1, "sd": "010101", "traffic_type": "embb"}], "network_layers": ["ran", "transport", "core"]}, "slos": [{"slo_id": "slo-urllc-lat", "metric": "latency_p95_ms", "target": 5, "slice_filter": {"traffic_type": "urllc"}}, {"slo_id": "slo-availability", "metric": "availability_pct", "target": 99.99, "measurement_window": "monthly"}], "description": "Critical e-government services on 5G - URLLC latency and overall availability.", "owner_team": "govtech-account-team"}

messages.content: Intent `intent-govtech-001` dicipta dalam status draft. Sebelum kita mula assurance session, perlu semak eligibility. Mahu saya jalankan sekarang?

messages.name: check_service_assurance_eligibility
messages.content: {"intent_id": "intent-govtech-001", "eligible": true, "check_results": {"slice_availability": "pass", "slo_feasibility": "warn", "contract_coverage": "pass", "probe_capacity": "pass"}, "warnings": [{"area": "slo_feasibility", "detail": "URLLC p95 latency target 5ms is tight - current baseline is 4.2ms with peak 5.8ms during business hours."}], "recommended_monitoring_profile": "high_frequency_5s"}

Encik, intent ELIGIBLE tetapi ada warning: URLLC latency target 5 ms agak ketat - baseline semasa 4.2 ms tetapi peak business hours 5.8 ms. Sistem cadang monitoring profile `high_frequency_5s`. Mahu saya start assurance session dengan profile tersebut?
Yes start session dengan high_frequency_5s. Session name 'govtech-prod-monitoring'.
Session `asess-govtech-77019` aktif sekarang dengan 2 probe locations dan sampling 5-saat. Mahu saya list assurance policies yang sedia ada untuk kita attach, dan semak status session sekali?

messages.name: list_assurance_policies
messages.content: {"policies": [{"policy_id": "pol-urllc-strict", "name": "URLLC Strict Latency Enforcement", "rule_count": 4, "applicable_to": ["urllc_slices"]}, {"policy_id": "pol-availability-critical", "name": "Critical Availability Policy 99.99", "rule_count": 3, "applicable_to": ["all_slices"]}, {"policy_id": "pol-jitter-low", "name": "Low Jitter URLLC", "rule_count": 2}], "total": 3}

Encik, 3 policy applicable; current metrics: URLLC latency p95 4.4 ms (within target), eMBB 18.2 ms, availability 99.998% - SEMUA sihat. Mahu saya attach 2 policy yang paling penting: `pol-urllc-strict` dan `pol-availability-critical`?
Yes attach kedua-dua. Target our assurance session.
Kedua-dua policy ditambah ke session dengan blocking enforcement. Setelah 15 minit running, mahu saya semak ada violation atau tidak?
Encik, **1 major violation**: URLLC slice latency p95 melampaui 5 ms (mencapai 5.7 ms selama 38 saat pada 9:03:42 AM). Patut buka incident assurance dan mula plan remediation. Mahu saya proceed?
Yes buka incident — title 'URLLC latency breach on GovTech slice', source assurance_engine. Pastu plan remediation strategy traffic_steering.

function.name: create_assurance_incident
function.arguments: {"source": "assurance_engine", "title": "URLLC latency breach on GovTech slice", "severity": "major", "detected_at": "2026-05-21T09:03:42+08:00", "related": {"assurance_session_id": "asess-govtech-77019", "violation_ids": ["viol-asess-001"], "intent_id": "intent-govtech-001"}, "description": "URLLC slice (sst=2, sd=010203) p95 latency reached 5.7ms exceeding 5ms SLO during 38s window."}

messages.content:
Encik:

- Incident `inc-asur-22019` dibuka (major).
- Remediation plan `rmp-77019` dengan 3 langkah: identify backup path -> shift 30% traffic ke Putrajaya -> validate (total ~37s).

Mahu saya update incident untuk link kepada remediation plan, dan execute plan secara dry-run dahulu untuk safety?
Yes update incident link, lepas tu execute dry-run.

function.name: update_assurance_incident
function.arguments: {"incident_id": "inc-asur-22019", "updates": {"linked_remediation_plan_id": "rmp-77019", "status": "investigating", "add_notes": "Linked traffic steering plan rmp-77019; executing dry-run before commit."}}

messages.name: execute_remediation_plan
messages.content: {"execution_id": "exec-rmp-77019-dry", "remediation_plan_id": "rmp-77019", "operation": "dry_run", "status": "completed", "predicted_outcome": {"projected_latency_p95_ms": 4.0, "projected_recovery_time_seconds": 12, "side_effects": ["30% traffic temporarily increased on Putrajaya probe"]}, "warnings": [], "completed_at": "2026-05-21T09:04:55+08:00"}
Dry-run berjaya: projected latency p95 4.0 ms selepas steering (turun dari 5.7), recovery time ~12 saat. Tiada warning. Mahu saya execute commit sekarang?
Encik, remediation **completed** - latency URLLC kini 4.1 ms (recovered). Mahu saya update incident kepada resolved, dan pin satu dashboard tile untuk monitor URLLC latency live?
Yes both. Pastu attach evidence — telemetry capture dari incident.

function.name: update_assurance_incident
function.arguments: {"incident_id": "inc-asur-22019", "updates": {"status": "resolved", "resolution_notes": "Latency restored to 4.1ms via traffic_steering plan rmp-77019. Total impact 38s.", "resolved_at": "2026-05-21T09:05:35+08:00"}}

messages.content:
Encik:

- Incident `inc-asur-22019` ditandakan **resolved**.
- Dashboard tile `tile-govtech-lat` dipin dengan threshold warn 4.5 ms / critical 5.0 ms.
- Evidence telemetry attached.

Mahu saya update assurance session juga supaya monitoring profile diperketatkan sedikit (mis. probe ke-3 sebagai backup), dan subscribe customer GovTech kepada slack notifications untuk future incidents?
Yes update session — tambah probe ke-3 di MY-Putrajaya. Pastu subscribe GovTech via webhook ke webhook URL https://govtech.gov.my/hooks/naas-alerts.

Encik:

- Session sekarang ada 3 probe.
- Webhook subscription `sub-govtech-44091` aktif untuk GovTech.

Mahu saya pull final KPI metrics untuk session untuk closing report?
Yes pull KPI last 24 jam. Pastu add comment kat incident sebagai post-mortem ringkas.

function.arguments: {"actor": {"actor_type": "ops_engineer", "actor_id": "naas-eng-ravi", "tenant_id": "telco-my-edge", "session_id": "sess-naas-2099"}, "entity_id": "inc-asur-22019", "body": "Post-mortem (preliminary): URLLC slice 010203 hit 5.7ms p95 for 38s during 09:03 AM. messages.content:
Encik, KPI 24-jam:

- Latency p95 avg 4.2 ms, max 5.7 ms
- Availability 99.998%
- 1 violation
- **MTTR 1.9 minit**

Post-mortem comment posted to GovTech account team. Adakah ada apa-apa lagi, Encik Ravi?
Sama-sama Encik Ravi. Session terus aktif dengan 3 probe; sila hubungi semula jika ada anomali. Selamat hari.
